sentences.text: 41.This Court has carefully perused the record, has heard ar- guments advanced by Ld. APP for the state as well as by Ld. Counsel for remaining accused persons and has care- fully gone through the entire material available on record and evidence led on behalf of the prosecution.

42.Before coming to the merits of the case, it becomes imper- ative to discuss the statutory ingredients of the offence for which accused no.2 Raj Rani, accused no.3 Parveen Gupta and accused no. 4 Parvesh Gupta have been charged with as well as the position of law regarding the same.
43.The offence of "cheating" has been defined under Section 415 of IPC which has been made punishable under Section 420 of IPC.

The relevant provisions have been reiterated as under:
"415.
